description: Build a high-throughput message broker that supports publish-subscribe patterns and partition offsets.
outcome: Demonstrates distributed message routing, thread-safe queuing, and custom TCP protocols.

description: Create a partitioned, replicated key-value storage engine using Raft consensus protocol.
outcome: Demonstrates consensus protocols, socket connections, and disk storage management.

project_name: API Gateway with Dynamic Rate Limiting
description: Implement a reverse proxy engine that routes requests and throttles requests using token bucket algorithm in Redis.
outcome: Demonstrates middleware development, rate limiting, and reverse proxy routing.

description: Write a coordinator service that manages multi-service updates using Saga pattern (compensating transactions).
outcome: Demonstrates event-driven transactional consistency, error boundaries, and state machines.

description: Create a Java service that dynamically switches data sources based on tenant request headers using Hibernate/Postgres.
outcome: Demonstrates tenant isolation patterns, pool pooling, and reflection configurations.

description: Create a high-speed log ingestion shipper that indexes system events into Elasticsearch database.
outcome: Demonstrates search query parsing, real-time log ingestion, and database indexing.

description: Implement a server that handles 50,000 active websocket connections, broadcasts messages via Redis pub-sub.
outcome: Demonstrates async connection management, channels, and low-latency network I/O.

description: Build an offline task scheduler that queues tasks in PostgreSQL and executes them using worker threads.
outcome: Demonstrates concurrent worker patterns, transactional locking, and task queues.

description: Build an inventory checkout blocker service using Redis Distributed Locks (Redlock) to prevent overselling.
outcome: Demonstrates concurrency control, lock lease handling, and caching.

description: Implement a driver selection backend using spatial indexes (Uber H3 Geo-hashing) and WebSocket communication.
outcome: Demonstrates geospatial queries, real-time telemetry pipelines, and fast matching loops.

description: Design and run a cache server that stores video segments and serves them via HTTP Range requests with LRU eviction.
outcome: Demonstrates storage design, network chunking, and memory eviction caching.

description: Build a stream processor that aggregates ad-click events per minute and displays metrics on a frontend chart.
outcome: Demonstrates stream joins, time-series data aggregation, and real-time frontend charts.

description: Build a multithreaded link indexer that respects robots.txt and crawls sites concurrently using BFS.
outcome: Demonstrates crawler state management, duplicate filtering, and rate limiting.

description: Create a prefix-matching auto-complete service using Trie data structures and high-speed memory caching.
outcome: Demonstrates prefix trees, input debouncing, and search indexing.

description: Build a high-performance gaming scoreboard using Redis Sorted Sets (ZSET) updating 10,000 ranks per second.
outcome: Demonstrates Redis data structures, sorted set updates, and score scoring logic.

description: Develop an Android notes app that caches edits in SQLite and syncs with backend via background workers.
outcome: Demonstrates offline database synchronization, network change listeners, and background sync.

description: Build a dashboard showing income, expenses, monthly budgets, and chart visualizations using Django and React.
outcome: Demonstrates basic full-stack APIs, database CRUD operations, and graphing charts.
